question.problem: The surface area of a cylinder is $24\pi \,{\text{mm}}^{2}$ and the ratio of its radius to its height is $3.$ Calculate the height of the cylinder.
question.worked_solution:
Let $r$ and $h$ be the radius and height of the cylinder, respectively. 

We are given that 

$$
\frac{r}{h}=3\,⟹\,r=3h.
$$

We can find the surface area of a cylinder using the formula

$$
S=2\pi {r}^{2}+2\pi rh.
$$

Substituting the values

$$
S=24\pi ,\,r=3h
$$

into the formula for $S,$ we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}S & =2\pi {r}^{2}+2\pi rh \\ 24\pi  & =2\pi (3h)^{2}+2\pi (3h)h \\ 24\pi  & =18\pi {h}^{2}+6\pi {h}^{2} \\ 24\pi  & =24\pi {h}^{2} \\ {h}^{2} & =\frac{24\pi }{24\pi } \\ {h}^{2} & =1 \\ h & =1\,\text{mm}\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that we disregard the negative solution since length must be positive.
